info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Trade Banking By Param1-spec
info.description: This API allows for the efficient update of trade banking credit facilities based on specific parameters. By utilizing the provided endpoint, users can modify details of a particular credit facility associated with a given identifier. Typical consumers include banking professionals and financial application developers who need to manage client credit facilities seamlessly. This operation supports dynamic adjustments to ensure that financial information remains up-to-date and accurate, reflecting the latest terms and conditions as required.

patch.description: This operation allows users to update details of a specific credit facility identified by RES-100045 in the trade banking system. Ensure that all required fields are provided in the request to successfully apply the changes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the details of the credit facility identified by RES-100045. Ensure that all required fields are populated to accurately reflect the changes to the facility.

200.description: The request was successful, and the resource has been updated.
